Worship and Media roles are left out. It is sent online (this computer can be off), to the email address in the member's record, from the email account of the prayer alerts (Beacon Pastor). Turn it on or off, Send a test to…, Send this week's now, and The last ones sent… (who got it, who has no email address). Needs Website Update 99 (rules 52) published from Beacon Pastor.
